Acceptance.description: A human's acceptance of one field: the value, its source span, and how it was reached.
Acceptance.title: Acceptance

AdjudicationItem.description: A conflict for the adjudicator. The AI column is not here; it opens after the commit.
AdjudicationItem.title: AdjudicationItem

AiInvolvement.description: Human exclusions the AI took part in. The AI alone never excludes.
AiInvolvement.title: AiInvolvement

Assertion.description: An accepted value as reports use it: the latest acceptance per semantic key.
Assertion.title: Assertion

AssignmentFullText.description: The full text behind a reviewer's full-text assignment.
AssignmentFullText.title: AssignmentFullText

AttemptView.description: One step of the waterfall for one report.
AttemptView.title: AttemptView

AuditStratum.description: Excluded records whose AI reading was, or was not, a verified exclusion.
AuditStratum.title: AuditStratum

ChainAudit.description:
Every check on every event and checkpoint, not only the first failure (`verify_chain`).

A tampered row shows up as the exact check it fails: a changed payload under its old hash
fails `payload_hash`; a re-hashed payload fails `event_hash`; a fully re-hashed event fails
the next event's `prev_hash`; a re-hashed tail fails the signed `checkpoint` that covers it;
a deleted event leaves a `seq` gap.
ChainAudit.title: ChainAudit

Checkpoint.description:
A signed statement that the chain of `project_id` had `head_hash` at `seq`.

Copies live outside the database, so a checkpoint still convicts a chain that an administrator
rewrote or cut, as long as the signing key was not theirs.
Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

CorpusReport.description:
One report of an identity revision with the source records that make it up.

`records` are in source order; a report found by several searches has one record per
occurrence. `relation` is the strongest link label among them.
CorpusReport.title: CorpusReport

CorpusView.description: The newest identity revision: every report with its records and study.
CorpusView.title: CorpusView

Criterion.description:
An executable eligibility criterion.

`text` states the condition. For an `include` criterion a record must meet it; for an
`exclude` criterion a record that shows it is excluded. Either way the judge answers whether
the record *passes*: `not_met` with a verified quote is what excludes.
Criterion.title: Criterion

CriterionDecision.description: A reviewer's reading of one criterion at full text, with the evidence for it.
CriterionDecision.title: CriterionDecision

Deviation.description: A justified departure from a required source plan, e.g. a source that cannot be searched.
Deviation.title: Deviation

DiffPreview.description:
What publishing a source would change against the version every decision reads now;
`previous` and `diff` are None before the first version.
DiffPreview.title: DiffPreview

FieldSource.description: Which source supplied one field, so a reviewer can see where a value came from.
FieldSource.title: FieldSource

Finding.description:
One check that failed, with what the row stores and what recomputing it gives.

`seq` is the event the check ran on; a checkpoint's finding names the seq it covers.
Finding.title: Finding

Interval.description: A point estimate with an interval.
Interval.title: Interval

Locate.description: Janus locator hints. `rows` are row labels (or text labels); `columns` column headers.
Locate.title: Locate

PageTriage.description: Whether a page's text layer can be trusted (pdf-inspector plus a PyMuPDF check).
PageTriage.title: PageTriage

PairAgreement.title: PairAgreement

ParsedSource.description: The source as data, or the syntax error as an issue with its line and column.
ParsedSource.title: ParsedSource

PublishedProtocol.description:
The version every decision reads now, with the words the review uses for core concepts:
the profile's labels where it has them, the core's otherwise.
PublishedProtocol.title: PublishedProtocol

QueueItem.description:
What a reviewer sees. Never contains AI output before their own provisional decision,
sentinel or audit flags, or anything of another reviewer.
QueueItem.title: QueueItem

QueueRecord.description: The record's facts as the queue shows them, with title highlights and abstract sections.
QueueRecord.title: QueueRecord

RecordEnrichmentView.description:
One source occurrence as enrichment completed it. `entities` index into
`title + " " + abstract`, the text the tags were anchored in.
RecordEnrichmentView.title: RecordEnrichmentView

RecordFacts.description: Bibliographic facts shown above the abstract.
RecordFacts.title: RecordFacts

RecordFlag.description: What the corpus list shows beside a record.
RecordFlag.title: RecordFlag

ReferenceSet.description: Known relevant records: the strategy is built on one set and validated on the other.
ReferenceSet.title: ReferenceSet

ReportInfo.description: What the review screen shows about the report; the corpus owns the real record.
ReportInfo.title: ReportInfo

RescreenGauge.description: Blind extra screens that AI-only disagreements sent to the auditor. Lead's view only.
RescreenGauge.title: RescreenGauge

RetrievalItem.description:
A report of the corpus and its full text, for the methods lead's upload queue. `outcomes`
holds the report's current outcome per screened scope and stage (`include`, `exclude`,
`conflict`, or None while it is being screened).
RetrievalItem.title: RetrievalItem

Reveal.description: Shown after a provisional decision when the AI disagrees (or always, if set so).
Reveal.title: Reveal

RevealTiming.description: When a reviewer saw the AI's reading, against their own blind decision.
RevealTiming.title: RevealTiming

ReviewField.description: One field to review: both paths' proposals for one semantic key, and the gate.
ReviewField.title: ReviewField

ReviewLayer.description: A layer without its words: the viewer loads words per page.
ReviewLayer.title: ReviewLayer

ReviewQuestion.description: One question or population of the review. Decisions are keyed by it as a scope.
ReviewQuestion.title: ReviewQuestion

ReviewerColumn.description: One human's final decision, pseudonymized as A, B, ...
ReviewerColumn.title: ReviewerColumn

RunListing.description: A run as the run list shows it: its report and how far review has come.
RunListing.title: RunListing

Scope.description: One review question or search topic that decisions are keyed by.
Scope.title: Scope

ScopeStatus.description:
Progress of a scope and stage.

A reviewer who screens or audits the stage sees only their own counts (`view == "reviewer"`,
hidden items included, no conflicts, no metrics). An adjudicator of the stage sees the
screening progress and, as `conflicts`, the adjudications pending for them, without
metrics. Anyone else (the methods lead) sees the whole stage.
ScopeStatus.title: ScopeStatus

ScreeningRecord.description:
One item to screen: a report at title and abstract, or its parsed full text.

`item_ref` names the record across modules (the corpus report ID); the judge's verdicts are
keyed by it.
ScreeningRecord.title: ScreeningRecord

Sentinel.description: A record with a known label, seeded invisibly into every screener's queue.
Sentinel.title: Sentinel

SourceProgress.description:
One source's part in a run: records it was asked about, records it filled a field of, and
records it failed for without answering, with the last reason it gave.
SourceProgress.title: SourceProgress

SourceRecord.description:
One record as a source returned it, before dedupe.

`occurrence_id` is assigned when the search module stores the execution; corpus and every
later stage refer to records by it.
SourceRecord.title: SourceRecord

StageProgress.description:
One stage as the viewer may see it. `outcomes` counts records by their current outcome
(`include`, `exclude`, `conflict`, `pending`) and is only filled in for the methods lead.
StageProgress.title: StageProgress

StoppingPlan.description: When an M3 topic may stop screening in AI order.
StoppingPlan.title: StoppingPlan

TracedEvent.description: A ledger event with who recorded it, what it means, and its place in the chain.
TracedEvent.title: TracedEvent

TracedOccurrence.description: One search result that the identity revision counts as this record.
TracedOccurrence.title: TracedOccurrence

WorkUpdate.description: A retraction, correction, or erratum that Crossref links to a work.
WorkUpdate.title: WorkUpdate
